title: Admit original Nanaware2024 lymph/DC quantities with sample and preparation distinctions
body:
Presto needs independent quantitative native-peptide and APC presentation measurements to test processing and a separately fitted MS-response term. The original Nanaware2024 workbooks and processed identification files are now recovered, but are not yet available through a released canonical Hitlist source/recipe.

Primary study: [PMID38848214 / PMC11233987](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11233987/), DOI10.1016/j.celrep.2024.114311. Deposits: PXD051024, PXD044801, PXD044885, PXD051618/MSV000094586 and PXD052267/MSV000094761.

## Recovered evidence

- All seven original workbooks, primary XML/rights metadata, human community SDRF and nine original mzIdentML files are pinned by URL, size and SHA256. No RAW acquisition or author/private access was required. PMC metadata records CC BY-NC-ND.
- Human S6(a) native lymph has1,783peptide-feature rows and1,783positive area cells. Its side-by-side protein summary has a different row order and derives from those native peptides; it is not independent precursor abundance.
- Mouse DC S4(e) has separate database-search and spectral-library blocks:1,581/1,020feature rows and2,536/4,632positive area cells. Separate intensity columns are retained. These algorithms reuse acquisitions and must not become independent replicates.
- Original deposited search entries provide3,430protein-reference records and23,455peptide-evidence alternatives across human/DC files. These are candidate origins, not measured precursor identities.
- Independent original XML decoding verifies121,346source cells and all32,995emitted quantity cells, including missing values, plus every deposited reference/evidence entry. PRIDE inventories reconcile4/13/50files and MassIVE132/44files.

## Metadata that must survive admission

1. Human material is native extracellular lymph from IBD subjects, not the free intracellular APC pool. Sample1 donor/pooling identity and pairing with the five-patient proteomics summaries remain unresolved.
2. DCs were expanded using B16-FLT3-L treatment before isolation. Do not label them untreated baseline APCs. Preserve mouse species/strain, cervical versus mesenteric origin, DC enrichment, MHC-II/I-Ab capture and intervention scope. No per-sample machinery KO state is supplied; unknown is not wildtype.
3. DC table description declares3cervical/6mesenteric replicates plus controls, but the quantity headers export3+3channels. Preserve this unresolved correspondence; do not manufacture samples. A methods paragraph also uses control/DSS lymph wording that does not establish DSS assignment for these DC channels.
4. Primary human native-peptide methods specify Q-Exactive HF; the community SDRF specifies Fusion Lumos. Preserve the source conflict instead of silently selecting one instrument.
5. Mouse S4(n) no-enzyme searches reuse files described under enzymatically digested proteomics. Do not treat these as native biological cleavage labels until actual preparation is resolved. Search enzyme settings are distinct from laboratory digestion.
6. Preserve source scores/filter provenance, modified forms, charges, alternative parents, raw coordinates, observed/missing/zero states, areas versus intensities and unqualified normalization. Predicted class-II cores are not measured registers. Same anatomy does not establish an exact specimen/aliquot join.

## Acceptance and downstream use

- Add a source family through the shared EvidenceStore/catalog/bindings with immutable original assets, typed contexts/samples/assertions, independent source-block rows, observation/quantity cells and reference/identification alternatives. No private Presto workbook curator.
- Keep unreviewed workbook blocks as source-only assets. Source admission must not silently become training eligibility, inferred detection negatives or calibrated concentrations.
- Verify real-source cells independently and test side-by-side row mismatches, search-output dependence, missingness, unsupported forms, header drift and tampering.
- Follow with a registered endpoint-specific recipe for observable relative composition, explicit confidence/form aggregation, all-parent alternatives/dependence and prospective splits. Any biological comparison should share its objective and frozen MS observer between exact and sampled methods and retain simple sequence/condition controls.

This supports, but does not complete, the APC availability goal. Current biological scores are unchanged. Search by PXD051024, PMID38848214 and PMC11233987 found no existing source owner; broader sample-anchor issue #362 and MS-response issue #762 remain related.
